name: MCP servers
title: MCP servers: another program's tools plugged into Rouh, such as GitHub, Notion or Linear, connected and tested on one page

permissions: opens the MCP servers the person connects - an address with the header or token they type, or, for an administrator, a command run on this machine with the values they type - and offers that server's tools in the person's own turns, each asking first unless they turn Ask first off; the header and environment values are sealed and only their last four are shown
opens the MCP servers named in the installation's setting (ROUH_MCP_SERVERS, ROUH_MCP_CONFIG) and shows them read-only
accounts: whatever service each connected MCP server reaches with the person's token
touches.remove: the Anatomy section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, mcppage.js/.css and their entry in settingsPages (app/runs.js), rouh/mcp_servers.py, rouh/web/mcp.py and its routes, the mcp_servers tool in rouh/tools.py and its area in rouh/toolsearch.py, _mcp in rouh/anatomy.py, mcp_attach and the saved servers in ToolRegistry.add_mcp_servers (rouh/tools.py), rouh/models/mcp.py, and this manifest; drop mcp_servers with a migration. The MCP client itself (rouh/mcp.py) and the setting stay, as they were before.
